out.title: 6 Yosemite Street, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
out.ogDescription:
Welcome to 6 Yosemite Street, Point Cook, a well-presented three-bedroom, two-bathroom home offering a spacious two-level layout, quality finishes and comfortable spaces for everyday living. Designed with a practical floorplan, this home offers a good balance of shared living areas and private spaces, making it a versatile choice for first homebuyers, downsizers or investors.

Stepping inside, the high ceilings and new timber flooring throughout create a fresh and welcoming feel. A separate living space at the front provides flexibility as a retreat, home office or second sitting area, while the open-plan living and dining area forms the main hub of the home. Filled with natural light, this space offers plenty of room to relax, enjoy meals and spend time together, with easy access to the outdoor area. The renovated kitchen features stone benchtops, tiled splashbacks and generous cabinetry, making everyday cooking simple.

Upstairs, three bedrooms provide comfortable accommodation, with the main bedroom features a renovated walk-in robe and ensuite. The second bedroom also includes a walk-in robe, while the third bedroom has a generous built-in robe and shares the main bathroom. Three additional double-glazed windows bring in extra natural light while adding to the home's everyday comfort. Outside, the fully landscaped backyard provides a low-maintenance space for outdoor meals, weekend gatherings or simply enjoying some fresh air, while the laundry and double garage with internal access add further practicality.

Zoned to Saltwater P-9 College, the home is also close to Sanctuary Lakes Shopping Centre, Point Cook Town Centre, kindergartens, parks, playgrounds and sporting facilities. Saltwater Reserve, and the Sanctuary Lakes golf course, gym, pool and tennis facilities are all within easy reach, with public transport and major roads making travel around Point Cook and beyond convenient.

out.title: 25 Jamaica Street, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
out.ogDescription:
Perfectly positioned in the heart of Point Cook, this spacious five-bedroom residence presents an excellent opportunity for families seeking space, flexibility and convenience in one of Melbourne’s popular family suburbs.

Set on an approximately 363sqm allotment, the home offers a generous floorplan with five bedrooms and three bathrooms, providing plenty of room for growing families, extended family living or those who simply value additional space.

At the centre of the home is a practical layout designed for comfortable everyday living, while the multiple bedrooms and bathrooms provide excellent flexibility for families of all stages. With secure accommodation for two cars, the property combines functionality with the space needed for modern family life.

Located within easy reach of Point Cook’s established amenities, the home is surrounded by schools, shopping centres, parks, public transport and everyday conveniences, making it an appealing choice for both owner-occupiers and investors.

Whether you are looking for a spacious family home or a solid investment opportunity, 25 Jamaica Street offers an exciting chance to secure a well-positioned property in a thriving Point Cook community.

Property Highlights

• Five generous bedrooms
• Three bathrooms
• Double car accommodation
• Approx. 363sqm land
• Family-friendly floorplan
• Convenient Point Cook location
• Close to schools, parks, shopping and local amenities
• Excellent opportunity for families or investors

An inspection is highly recommended to appreciate the space, versatility and location this property has to offer.

out.title: 94 Bondi Parade, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
out.ogDescription:
Perfectly positioned in the highly sought-after Saltwater Coast estate, 94 Bondi Parade, Point Cook presents an impressive family residence where exceptional quality, generous proportions and effortless indoor-outdoor living come together beautifully.

From the moment you step inside, the home makes an immediate impression with stunning timber flooring flowing through the entry, hallway and expansive open-plan living areas. Designed with modern family living and entertaining in mind, the thoughtfully considered floorplan offers four generous bedrooms, a versatile study or fifth bedroom, multiple living zones and exceptional outdoor entertaining spaces.

At the front of the home, a spacious formal lounge provides a peaceful retreat, while the expansive open-plan kitchen, meals and family area forms the true heart of the residence.

The gourmet kitchen is a standout feature, showcasing stone benchtops with waterfall edges, elegant pendant lighting, a stainless steel freestanding cooker, rangehood, stainless steel dishwasher and a large butler's pantry. With abundant storage and generous preparation space, it is perfectly equipped for both everyday family life and entertaining.

The luxurious master suite offers a private sanctuary, complete with a large double walk-in robe and beautifully appointed ensuite, featuring an oversized shower and stylish feature niche. Three additional bedrooms are generously proportioned and serviced by a spacious central bathroom with a relaxing bathtub.

Adding exceptional flexibility is the dedicated study or fifth bedroom, complete with a striking barn door that adds character while allowing the space to adapt effortlessly to the needs of a growing family.

Entertaining is made effortless with doors opening from the main living area onto a spectacular backyard, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. The beautifully landscaped backyard features established gardens and a generous grassed area, providing an ideal space for children, pets and relaxed family gatherings. Established, low-maintenance front gardens further enhance the home's impressive street appeal.

Additional highlights include:

Ducted heating and evaporative cooling
Roller blinds
Downlights throughout living
Double remote-control garage
Alarm system
Quality timber flooring
Expansive timber entertaining deck

Combining exceptional craftsmanship, generous living proportions and sophisticated entertaining spaces, this outstanding residence offers an enviable lifestyle in one of Point Cook's most desirable family communities.

Lifestyle & Location

Enjoy the exceptional lifestyle offered by Saltwater Coast, with residents having access to the renowned Saltwater Coast Lifestyle Centre, featuring swimming pools, tennis courts, a fully equipped gym, café and rooftop function space with panoramic city views.

Everyday convenience is also within easy reach, with Sanctuary Lakes Shopping Centre, IGA Saltwater and Saltwater Reserve all nearby. Families are well catered for with access to Saltwater P-9 College and Homestead Senior Secondary College, while local bus services provide convenient transport options.

With excellent community amenities, quality schools and easy access to major transport routes, 94 Bondi Parade offers the perfect balance of space, sophistication, comfort and lifestyle convenience.
